title: vandenboschia × quelpaertensis
intro: Vandenboschia × quelpaertensis, commonly known as Quelpaert fern, is a rare and unique species of fern that is a natural hybrid between Vandenboschia radicans and Quelpaertia formosana. This plant is traditionally used in Asian medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Quelpaert fern include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, making it a sought-after ingredient in traditional remedies. Bioactive constituents of Vandenboschia × quelpaertensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
